sources.title: Typesafe system one models and new /v1/decisions endpoint
sources.snippet: POST /v1/decisions is the unified Bifrost format. Send state plus a map of named questions - noul for probabilities, choice for classifications, score for rubrics - and get one typed answer per question, with confidence, probabilities, and legend metadata normalized into a single value field. sources.snippet: Bifrost is a high-performance AI gateway that unifies access to 23+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, and more) through a single OpenAI-compatible API. Deploy in seconds with zero configuration and get automatic failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and enterprise-grade features.

sources.snippet: Manifold runs thousands of GPU-parallel robot policy evaluations with custom rubrics and agentic failure analysis. Insights in 30 minutes, not days.

sources.title: Bifrost AI Gateway - Bifrost
sources.snippet: Enable AI models to discover and execute external tools dynamically via the Model Context Protocol. Bifrost acts as both an MCP client and server, connecting to external tool servers and exposing tools to clients like Claude Desktop.
